description: Navigation shell replacement and full restyle of all 6 screens (courier_shell, 5 courier screens + login). Depends on FEAT-001 (all widgets and tokens must exist first). No logic changes — only visual layer. All provider method calls, navigation routes, and data-binding remain byte-for-byte identical to the originals.
steps: 1. Rewrite lib/screens/courier/courier_shell.dart — Keep exported class name `CourierShell` (StatefulWidget). Replace the NavigationBar bottom nav with a custom `_BhBottomBar` StatelessWidget. Structure: Scaffold(body: IndexedStack(index:_idx, children:[CourierDashboardScreen(), CourierOrdersScreen(), CourierEarningsScreen(), CourierProfileScreen()]), bottomNavigationBar: _BhBottomBar(...)). _BhBottomBar is a StatelessWidget with params: int selectedIndex, ValueChanged<int> onTap, bool isOnline. It builds a Container(height:64+MediaQuery.padding.bottom, color:Theme.of(context).brightness==dark?kDarkSurfaceBase:kSurfaceBase, child: Stack with Column below and FAB above). The row has 5 slots: index 0=Home, 1=Parcels, 2=Scan(center), 3=Earnings, 4=Profile. IndexedStack has only 4 children; tapping Scan slot calls Navigator.pushNamed(context,'/courier/scan') — does NOT change _idx. Each non-scan tab slot: GestureDetector(onTap:()=>onTap(mappedIndex), child: Container(min 48dp, Column([Stack(Icon+online badge for Home), SizedBox(4), if selected: Text(label,kLabelSm,kBrand800)]))), with 2dp kBrand400 top indicator line when selected. Online badge: if isOnline && slot==Home: Positioned(top:0,right:0, Container(8dp circle, kOnlineDot)). Scan slot: GestureDetector(child: Column([Container(56x56, decoration:BoxDecoration(color:kBrand800, shape:BoxShape.circle, boxShadow:[...]), child:Icon(Icons.qr_code_scanner,white)), Text('Scan',kLabelSm,kTextMuted)])) — positioned 10dp above bar top via Stack negative topMargin. Semantics on scan: label='Scan parcel'. initState logic: role guard + cp.loadDashboard() — identical to original. _onTabTap mapping: 0→loadDashboard, 1→loadOrders, 2→loadEarnings, 3→loadProfile — identical to original.

2. Modify lib/screens/courier/courier_dashboard_screen.dart — Import bh_app_bar.dart, bh_skeleton.dart, bh_stat_tile.dart, bh_status_chip.dart, bh_offline_banner.dart, bh_empty_state.dart, app_tokens.dart. Changes: (a) Replace `appBar: TaptapNavBar(...)` with `appBar: BhAppBar(title:'Dashboard', showBack:false, actions:[IconButton(Icons.refresh,...)])`. (b) Replace `const LoadingCenter()` in loading branch with `SkeletonList(count:3)`. (c) In _WelcomeBanner: replace `gradient: C.heroGrad` BoxDecoration with `color: kBrand800`. (d) In _StatsRow: replace each `_stat(...)` Container+Column widget call with `BhStatTile(value:..., label:..., icon:..., iconColor:...)`. (e) In _ParcelCard (private, Map<String,dynamic>-based): replace `StatusPill(status:status, small:true)` with `BhStatusChip(status:status, size:BhChipSize.small)`. (f) Replace `_emptyParcels()` with `BhEmptyState(icon:Icons.inbox_outlined, title:'No active parcels', subtitle:'New assignments will appear here')`. (g) Wrap Scaffold body with `BhOfflineBanner(child: ...)`. (h) Replace all hardcoded Color(0xFF...) literals with token refs. ALL logic preserved: loadDashboard call in initState, _confirmAction dialog, markPickedUp/markDelivered calls, toggleOnlineStatus, _WelcomeBanner online toggle GestureDetector.

3. Modify lib/screens/courier/courier_orders_screen.dart — Import bh_app_bar.dart, bh_skeleton.dart, bh_parcel_card.dart, bh_offline_banner.dart, bh_empty_state.dart, app_tokens.dart. Changes: (a) Remove `with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin`; remove `TabController _tabs`; add `String? _filterStatus` state field; remove `_tabs.dispose()` from dispose(). (b) Replace `appBar: TaptapNavBar(title:'My Parcels', showBack:false, bottomHeight:48, bottom: TabBar(...))` with `appBar: BhAppBar(title:'My Parcels', showBack:false)`. (c) Replace `TabBarView` body with a Column: first child is a horizontal filter chip row, second child is Expanded(ListView or EmptyState). Filter chip row: SingleChildScrollView(scrollDirection:horizontal, child: Row) with 4 chips (All/Pickup/On the Way/Delivered) — each chip is a GestureDetector(Container with border/color toggle: selected=kBrand500 bg + white text, unselected=kSurfaceBase bg + kBorderDefault border + kTextSecondary text; padding EdgeInsets.symmetric(h:12,v:8), radius kRadiusFull). Selected chip filter: null=All, 'ready_for_pickup'=Pickup, 'out_for_delivery'=On the Way, 'delivered'=Delivered. (d) Replace `_ParcelCard(order:o, cp:cp)` with `BhParcelCard(order:o, cp:cp)`. (e) Replace `const LoadingCenter()` with `SkeletonList(count:5)`. (f) Replace `EmptyState(...)` with `BhEmptyState(...)`. (g) Wrap body column in `BhOfflineBanner(child: ...)`. (h) Keep _tabDefs definition as data source for filter chip labels/statuses. Keep _filtered() helper. Keep loadOrders() in initState.

4. Modify lib/screens/courier/courier_earnings_screen.dart — Import bh_app_bar.dart, bh_skeleton.dart, bh_empty_state.dart, bh_offline_banner.dart, app_tokens.dart. Changes: (a) Replace `appBar: TaptapNavBar(...)` with `appBar: BhAppBar(title:'Earnings', showBack:false, actions:[IconButton(Icons.refresh,...)])`. (b) Replace loading `const LoadingCenter()` with `SkeletonList(count:4)`. (c) In _buildBody: replace hero card `gradient: C.heroGrad` with `color: kBrand800`. Update child text styles to remain white (Colors.white explicit). (d) Replace `EmptyState(...)` with `BhEmptyState(icon:Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined, title:'No earnings data', subtitle:'Complete deliveries to see your earnings here')`. (e) Wrap body in `BhOfflineBanner(child: ...)`. (f) Replace all hardcoded Color literals with token consts. All logic preserved: loadEarnings in initState, _buildBody, _HistoryItem, _heroPeriod.

5. Modify lib/screens/courier/courier_profile_screen.dart — Import bh_app_bar.dart, bh_offline_banner.dart, app_tokens.dart, theme_service.dart. Changes: (a) Replace `appBar: const TaptapNavBar(title:'My Profile', showBack:false)` with `appBar: BhAppBar(title:'My Profile', showBack:false)`. (b) Replace gradient header Container `decoration: BoxDecoration(gradient:C.heroGrad, ...)` with `color: kBrand800`. (c) Add theme selector section after the earnings summary card and before personal info: a FieldCard(title:'Appearance', titleIcon:Icons.palette_outlined, children:[Row of 3 GestureDetector chips]) where each chip label = 'System'/'Light'/'Dark' and calls `context.read<ThemeService>().setMode(AppThemeMode.system/light/dark)`. Selected chip highlighted with kBrand500 bg + white text; unselected kSurfaceBase + kBorderDefault. (d) Wrap SingleChildScrollView body in `BhOfflineBanner(child: ...)`. (e) Replace all hardcoded Color literals with token consts. All logic preserved: loadProfile/loadEarnings in initState, _logout dialog, _whitePill, _accountStatusPill.

6. Modify lib/screens/courier/parcel_detail_screen.dart — Import bh_app_bar.dart, bh_skeleton.dart, bh_status_chip.dart, bh_offline_banner.dart, app_tokens.dart. Changes: (a) Replace `appBar: TaptapNavBar(...)` with `appBar: BhAppBar(title: _order!=null?'Parcel #${_order!.id}':'Parcel Details', showBack:true, actions:[IconButton(Icons.refresh,...)])`. (b) Replace `const LoadingCenter()` with `SkeletonList(count:6)`. (c) In _StatusBanner: replace `StatusPill(status:order.status)` with `BhStatusChip(status:order.status)`. (d) Wrap body in `BhOfflineBanner(child: ...)`. (e) Replace hardcoded Color literals with token consts. All logic preserved: _load() in initState, _buildError, markPickedUp/markDelivered, _confirmAction dialog.

7. Modify lib/screens/auth/login_screen.dart — Change: In _card() method, locate the header section (the Center widget containing the gradient Container with two_wheeler icon + 'Rider Login' Text + subtitle Text). Wrap that Center widget in an `AnimatedContainer(duration: Duration(milliseconds:200), height: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom>0 ? 80.0 : 180.0, clipBehavior: Clip.hardEdge, curve: Curves.easeInOut, child: Center(...))`. The AnimatedContainer replaces the bare Center — only the header section height animates. Set `resizeToAvoidBottomInset: true` on Scaffold (change from false) so the scroll area adjusts. All other login logic is byte-for-byte identical: _formKey, _emailCtrl, _passCtrl, _obscure, _rememberMe, _loadRemembered(), _login() method, remember-me/forgot-password row, _LoginButton, role dispatch.
acceptance_criteria: CourierShell renders 4-tab IndexedStack with custom bottom bar (no NavigationBar/BottomNavigationBar)
Scan center button calls Navigator.pushNamed(context, '/courier/scan') — does not change tab index
Online badge appears on Home tab icon when cp.isOnline == true
All 4 tab tap handlers still call loadDashboard/loadOrders/loadEarnings/loadProfile respectively
CourierDashboardScreen shows SkeletonList while loadingDash == true
CourierDashboardScreen welcome banner has flat kBrand800 background (no gradient)
CourierOrdersScreen shows horizontal filter chips replacing the TabBar
CourierOrdersScreen uses BhParcelCard for each order in the list
CourierEarningsScreen hero card has flat kBrand800 background (no gradient)
CourierProfileScreen shows theme selector row (System/Light/Dark chips)
Tapping a theme chip calls ThemeService.setMode() with correct enum value
ParcelDetailScreen AppBar title shows 'Parcel #N' when order is loaded
ParcelDetailScreen uses BhStatusChip replacing StatusPill in _StatusBanner
LoginScreen header section animates between 180dp and 80dp when keyboard opens/closes
All login logic (remember-me, validation, auth call, role dispatch) unchanged
flutter analyze lib/screens/ exits with no issues
findings: All 6 screens rewritten with zero logic changes. Key notes for FEAT-003+: (1) CourierShell uses a custom _BhBottomBar with a Stack — the Scan FAB lifts 10dp above bar top via Positioned(top:-10). Navigator.pushNamed('/courier/scan') is wired; that route must be registered when the Scan screen is added. (2) courier_profile_screen imports theme_service.dart directly and uses context.watch<ThemeService>() — ThemeService must be in the MultiProvider tree (should already be from FEAT-001 wiring in main.dart). (3) BhOfflineBanner wraps every screen body; it requires Expanded() parent since it uses Column+Expanded internally — all usages here are inside Scaffold.body which is already flex-contained. (4) Online badge on Home slot uses slot==0 (not tabIdx), correctly matching the mapping. (5) flutter analyze lib returns 'No issues found' after fixing three prefer_const_constructors in courier_profile_screen.dart.
